summary: Baozun Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq- and Hong Kong-listed e-commerce and brand management company, furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 17, 2026, attaching its Hong Kong interim report for the first six months of fiscal 2026 as Exhibit 99.1, satisfying Chapter 19C and Rule 13.48(1) requirements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory clock is stated; the filing is a routine semi-annual reporting obligation. The risk-arb angle is absent, as no special-situation event exists to trade against.
